mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS id, d.tag_code AS tag_code, d.tag_name AS tag_name, d.tag_group AS tag_group, d.color AS color, d.tag_type AS tag_type, d.rule_hint AS rule_hint, d.rule_metric AS rule_metric, d.rule_op AS rule_op, d.rule_value AS rule_value, d.rule_window_days AS rule_window_days, d.description AS description, d.sort_no AS sort_no, d.is_enabled AS is_enabled, d.create_time AS create_time, COUNT(t.id) AS customer_count FROM customer_tag_def d LEFT JOIN customer_tag t ON t.tenant_code = d.tenant_code AND t.tag_id = d.id AND t.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE d.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND d.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY d.id, d.tag_code, d.tag_name, d.tag_group, d.color, d.tag_type, d.rule_hint, d.rule_metric, d.rule_op, d.rule_value, d.rule_window_days, d.description, d.sort_no, d.is_enabled, d.create_time ORDER BY d.tag_group, d.sort_no, d.id

SELECT DISTINCT d.tenant_code FROM customer_tag_def d WHERE d.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.is_enabled = TRUE AND d.tag_type = 2 AND d.rule_metric IS NOT NULL AND d.rule_op IS NOT NULL AND d.rule_value IS NOT NULL
